name: fast-ios-device-test
description: Fast iOS UI-flow verification on Simulator, physical iPhone and CarPlay from a local macOS agent.

interface.longDescription: Verify focused iOS UI flows quickly on Simulator, a connected physical iPhone, or a mixed phone and CarPlay rig. The plugin writes guarded JSON flows, drives real UI interactions, records video when requested, reviews runs, and prepares captioned PR evidence. It runs only on a local Mac and requires Xcode 26 or 27; physical-device runs also require a development profile for the connected iPhone.
capabilities: Run mixed phone and CarPlay flows
Record and review UI test sessions
defaultPrompt: Set up Fast iOS Device Test on this Mac.
Verify this iOS flow on Simulator and record it.
Run this UI flow on my connected iPhone.
Run this mixed phone and CarPlay flow.

publication.release_notes: Adds a portable Codex plugin package with guided local setup.
